trial.prompt:
本版本在既有批量审批（POST /purchases/bulk-approve）、批量驳回（POST /purchases/bulk-reject）、重新提交（POST /purchases/{id}/reopen）与批量改派（POST /purchases/bulk-reassign）的基础上，新增申请撤回：POST /purchases/{id}/withdraw，请求体严格为 {"reason":"..."}，reason 为 1..200 字节。只有已认证的 requester 可以调用，并且只能撤回本人在当前租户中创建、状态为 submitted 的采购单；成功后该采购单 status 变为 withdrawn，其他列都不变。找不到目标、目标属于其他租户、不是本人创建或状态不是 submitted 时返回 4xx，数据库全部不变。请求体、身份、报文上限和 Idempotency-Key 校验由共享 HTTP 适配器 protocol.Item 完成（verb 为 withdraw，role 为 requester），新路径通过它注册。成功返回 200，响应为 {"id":ID,"status":"withdrawn"}。首次成功 Idempotency-Replayed=false；同一 actor 以同一 key 重放同一目标时，返回相同状态和响应字节，header=true，不产生新写入；同 key 不同目标返回 409。不同 actor 使用同名 key 互不影响。幂等结果与撤回在同一事务中写入 ActionRequest：operation 为 "withdraw.v7"，tenantId、actorId、key 分别为当前租户、当前用户和 Idempotency-Key 原值，response 为响应 JSON 对象，每个成功的新请求恰好一行。ActionRequest 写入失败时返回 503 且数据库全部不变，故障移除后同 key 可重试。并发：同 key 同请求两次均 200 且只提交一次；不同 key 同时撤回同一采购单时恰好一个返回 200、另一个返回 4xx，只撤回一次。撤回后的采购单不能再被批量审批、批量驳回、重新提交或改派（4xx，数据库不变）。approver 调用返回 403，未认证返回 401；客户端上下文头不能覆盖认证身份。批量审批、批量驳回、重新提交、批量改派与原有 API 行为保持不变。
Add the withdraw Action described above to the existing service.
Read the existing code first and follow its conventions.
The database uses guarded RLS. The shared HTTP adapter in internal/protocol validates input and binds demo identity; register the new path with protocol.Item.
Only edit/add internal/candidate/ Go code. All other exports, dependencies, Git settings and tests are protected.
Preserve the existing APIs, including bulk-approve, bulk-reject, reopen and bulk-reassign.
Do not commit/push, read credentials, other checkouts or evaluator materials; do not use other agents.
Use go build ./... and go test ./... as needed. Private database credentials are unavailable during generation. The public SQL schema is in SCHEMA.sql.
Capability: no platform Action kernel. The existing batch approval, batch rejection, reopen and bulk reassign are hand-written in internal/candidate/.
This is a trusted-code pilot; directory export alone does not enforce host or network isolation.
